description:
Create a comprehensive end-to-end CLI test suite for benchbox that executes
the CLI completely and evaluates result output files to confirm correct execution.

Tests are grouped by platform types:
- Local platforms (DuckDB, SQLite, DataFusion, PostgreSQL)
- Cloud platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Athena, Databricks)
- DataFrame platforms (Pandas, Polars, Dask, PySpark, cuDF)

The goal is to test all primary code paths users would touch to ensure product
functionality before shipping. This includes:
- Full benchmark execution with result validation
- Output file structure verification
- Phase execution completeness
- Error handling and edge cases
- CLI options and flags coverage
